pageTitle: Food & Beverage Management | Digital Marketing | Hospitality Operations
name: Hein Htet Kyaw
contactText: Open to professional opportunities, hospitality management roles, digital marketing projects, business collaborations, and meaningful connections with industry professionals.
aboutText:
My professional journey began in frontline hospitality service and progressed through supervisory and management roles in hotels, restaurants, and Food & Beverage operations.

Throughout my career, I have gained practical experience in restaurant and bar management, hotel operations, staff training and development, guest relations, cost control, and business administration. My professional background includes roles as Food & Beverage Manager, Hotel Operations Manager, and Assistant Digital Marketing Manager.

In digital marketing, my experience covers social media planning, Facebook and TikTok content creation, photography, videography, video editing, and promotional campaigns for hospitality businesses.

I believe that combining operational excellence, strong leadership, and creative digital marketing can help businesses deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve long-term growth. I am committed to continuous learning, professional development, and delivering meaningful value through my work.
